name: parallel-feature-development
architecture: Neural Orchestra v5 Contract-First Vertical Slicing
description: Guides high-throughput concurrent feature execution across Macro Vertical Engineers against locked executable contracts.

phases.name: Executable Contract Lock & Stream Scoping
phases.instructions: Lock executable TypeScript contracts and assign vertical slice file ownership.

phases.name: Parallel Vertical Slice Execution
phases.instructions: Run independent vertical streams concurrently against locked contracts.ts. Each engineer runs node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs locally.

phases.name: Zero-Token Deterministic Quality Gate
phases.instructions: Run node .agents/bin/quality-gate.mjs. If failed, map-failures and dispatch back to owning vertical engineers (capped at 3 retries).

phases.name: Multi-Stream Integration & E2E Validation
phases.instructions: Validate end-to-end integration across merged streams and verify git diff.
